hero.description: From paper menus to digital — from tableside ordering to kitchen displays, we build smart solutions that modernize your restaurant.

whatIs.label: Is This Page For You?
whatIs.title: Is Your Restaurant Ready for the Digital Age?
whatIs.paragraph1: Paper menus wear out, take time to update and raise hygiene concerns. Order mistakes, long wait times and staff workload make running your restaurant harder.
whatIs.paragraph2: QR menus are no longer just a trend — they've become a standard requirement for restaurants in terms of speed, hygiene and customer experience.
whatIs.paragraph3: At Sybor Digital, we build digital solutions tailored to your restaurant — from QR menus to tableside ordering, kitchen displays to loyalty programs.

physical.title: I have a restaurant or café
physical.description: I want to streamline my operations with a QR menu and ordering system.

startup.title: I manage a chain of venues
startup.description: I want centralized menu management across all my branches.

growing.title: I have a hotel or resort
growing.description: I want to digitize room service and restaurant orders.

global.title: I'm in a food court or mall
global.description: I want a digital menu system suited to multi-venue management.

whatWeDo.label: What We Do
whatWeDo.title: We Digitize Your Restaurant End to End
whatWeDo.paragraph1: We set up the entire flow — from a digital menu that opens with a QR scan to tableside order terminals, kitchen displays to payment systems.
whatWeDo.paragraph2: Update the menu yourself — no technical support needed to change prices, add daily specials or introduce seasonal menus.
whatWeDo.paragraph3: We help you manage your restaurant with data through order analytics, best-selling product reports and customer feedback.
whatWeDo.cardDescription: Every digital solution your restaurant needs — under one roof.

admin.title: Sales Analytics

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: How long does the system take to go live?
delivery.answer: The core QR menu system is typically ready in 1-2 weeks, the full system with ordering and payment integration in 3-4 weeks.

pricing.question: How does pricing work?
pricing.answer: We work with a one-time setup fee and monthly subscription model. Custom pricing is available based on number of branches.

revisions.question: Can I update the menu myself?
revisions.answer: Yes. You can easily change prices, add or remove products on your own.

maintenance.question: Does the system work without internet?
maintenance.answer: We have offline mode support. Basic menu display continues to work when the connection drops.

migration.question: Does it integrate with our existing POS?
migration.answer: We can integrate with popular POS systems. We evaluate your current system during the discovery call.

mobile.question: Do customers need to download an app?
mobile.answer: No. Customers who scan the QR code see the menu directly in their browser. No app download required.
